# PositionScope

> Independent, read-only Binance research app for macOS. Current download metadata: v0.2.2. Native UI, packaged Keychain prompts, real accounts and model reasoning quality remain separately unverified.

## Product
- [Overview](https://positionscope.funagent.app/): Compact portfolio popup and independent evidence workspace
- [English overview](https://positionscope.funagent.app/en/): Scope and limitations
- [Downloads](https://positionscope.funagent.app/download/): Actual release and verification links
- [Methodology](https://positionscope.funagent.app/guides/portfolio-risk/): Facts, events, depth and forward price observations
- [Read-only setup](https://positionscope.funagent.app/guides/read-only-api/): Binance permissions and model configuration
- [Privacy](https://positionscope.funagent.app/privacy/): Encrypted settings versus local public research records
- [Roadmap](https://positionscope.funagent.app/roadmap/): Acceptance gaps and next research questions
- [Source](https://github.com/hash-panda/positionscope): MIT-declared repository

Research covers Binance USDT perpetuals, not all crypto markets. Event screening is cross-sectional, not proof of historical anomaly or early value. Public AI research uses at most two explicit-action model calls, only validated public facts and no account positions/equity. Separate portfolio analysis is opt-in and sends sensitive position-level risk facts to the selected provider. Model IDs remain explicit except for the verified DeepSeek alias.

Alerts are in-app and require the process to be running and online. Frozen judgments retain failures and abstentions. Optional future price observations are indicative, unleveraged price changes, not executable trades or net returns; fees, funding, slippage, predictive quality and costs are unknown.

Settings use macOS Keychain-managed encryption without plaintext fallback. Public research, watch rules and alerts use atomic local 0600 JSON files, not encryption. No old-preview migration, automatic trading, funds transfer, profit forecast or exchange affiliation. Manual update checks open the official release page and do not install software.
